name: HealthCare Information Security and Privacy Practitioner

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded HIPAA and healthcare focus forms a sector-specific privacy/security specialization; accreditation supports credibility, but limited hiring volume and jurisdictional scope do not map cleanly to general seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accredited healthcare privacy and HIPAA coverage is best expressed as a sector specialty. Its two-year profile and lower hiring volume limit broader security seniority conclusions outside healthcare.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded healthcare and HIPAA focus is a distinct vertical extension of security and privacy practice. Specialty better expresses that narrow applicability than the broader professional hints, especially for an EU offensive consultant.
